name: embedfinder
description: Turn video page links into ready-to-publish entries: title, description, thumbnail, tags, date, duration and embeddable players.

interface.longDescription:
Paste a video page link and get a ready-to-publish entry: title, description, thumbnail, tags, publish date, duration and the embeddable player URLs the page publishes, ranked best first. Works with YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion and any public page with Open Graph, JSON-LD (VideoObject) or WordPress markup. It can also expand a category, archive or listing page into the URLs of its entries, so you can process a whole section of a site.

Embedfinder only reads public pages. It never downloads, stores or re-hosts videos, and it cannot post, edit or delete anything. Each URL uses 1 extraction from your Embedfinder account quota.
capabilities: List the entries of a listing page
defaultPrompt: Get the title, thumbnail and embed player of this video: https://vimeo.com/1084537
List the entries on this page: https://wordpress.org/news/category/releases/
How many Embedfinder extractions do I have left?

positive.prompt: Get the title, description, thumbnail and embed player of this video: https://vimeo.com/1084537
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the entry for Big Buck Bunny: title, description, thumbnail URL and the player URL https://player.vimeo.com/video/1084537.

positive.prompt: I want to publish this video on my blog. Give me its title, thumbnail and embed code: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aqz-KE-bpKQ
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the title and thumbnail of the YouTube video and the embed player https://www.youtube.com/embed/aqz-KE-bpKQ, then writes an iframe embed code with it.

positive.prompt: Which embeddable players does this page publish? https://embedfinder.com/ejemplo
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the entry for the page with two players (a YouTube embed and a Vimeo embed) listed best first, plus its title and thumbnail.

positive.prompt: List the posts on this page and tell me if there is a next page: https://wordpress.org/news/category/releases/
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the URLs of the posts linked from the category page in site order and the URL of the next page.

positive.prompt: How many Embedfinder extractions do I have left this period?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports used, limit, remaining and whether the period is a day or a month, without using any extraction.

negative.prompt: Download this YouTube video as an MP4 file for me: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aqz-KE-bpKQ
Post this video to my WordPress site and delete the old post.
What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. Paid Embedfinder plans are bought on embedfinder.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: extract video metadata and embeddable players, list the entries of a listing page and check the remaining quota.

es-ES.subtitle: De link de video a ficha lista
es-ES.description: Pegá el link de una página de video y obtené la ficha lista para publicar: título, descripción, miniatura, etiquetas, fecha, duración y los reproductores embebibles que publica la página, ordenados del mejor al peor. Funciona con YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion y cualquier página pública con Open Graph, JSON-LD (VideoObject) o WordPress. También convierte una página de categoría o listado en las direcciones de sus entradas. Solo lee páginas públicas: nunca descarga, guarda ni vuelve a subir videos, y no puede publicar, editar ni borrar nada. Cada dirección usa 1 extracción del cupo de tu cuenta de Embedfinder.
